evals.prompt: Ok, l'export in PDF funziona, committa e apri la PR.
evals.expected_output: Before committing: runs the gate (verify skill or the contract's Completion gate), then the Standard and Specifica self-review of the whole diff, shows the short report, and only then commits, pushes and opens the PR.

evals.prompt: Abbiamo finito la slice del filtro per data, chiudila.
files: the build fails with a type error in FiltroData.vue
evals.expected_output: Stops at the gate: reports the failing build, fixes it inside the slice's file scope or asks, and does not commit.

evals.prompt: Committa la correzione del refuso nel README.
evals.expected_output: Does not run the gate: documentation-only change, follows the docs-only exception and the per-repo git policy.

evals.prompt: Pusha la slice della migrazione dello schema IndexedDB (risk:high).
evals.expected_output: Runs the two review axes as two separate subagents with self-contained briefs (contract + per-repo + diff; task or plan + diff) before the commit.

evals.prompt: Ho cambiato il calcolo degli sconti nel metodo CalcolaTotale: niente cambia a video, ma i totali ora escludono le spese di spedizione. Committa.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as an observable behaviour change even without UI changes: adds a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry and updates the documents the Mappa della documentazione ties to data or behaviour changes (or the README and living docs if there is no map) in the same commit.
